title: allay_regen
description: A serverside fabric mod that allows the user to configure lag friendly healing for allays, so that they don't die so frequently.
body:
This mod heals allays in the world every set amount of time.
![configuration screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ce79379c00c06210d8c8d36b3ef6e6dbe6b663.png)
It's very lag friendly because it doesn't heall all the allays in a single tick, which could result in lag spikes if there are a lot of allays, instead it heals them gradually using the "maxAllaysPerHeal" value from the config.
